template.facts_first: In insula Piscatorum cellarium continet amphorarum vini numerum {T}. In insula Cypressorum cellarium continebat amphorarum vini numerum {M}, sed nautae ex eo amphorarum numerum {S} in continentem transvexerunt.

template.gloss_en: On the island of Piscatores the cellar holds a number of wine amphorae equal to {T}. I want to know how many amphorae of wine are left in the cellar of the island of Cypressi.
template.notes: Indirect question, unsigned. The cellar on the other island is T. ex: lighthouse catalogue number. sem: cellar of a third island.

template.facts_first: Superiore censu in qualibet domo habitabant incolae, quorum numerus erat {T}. Hoc censu domuum recensitarum numerus fuit {M}, et in qualibet domo habitabant incolae, quorum numerus erat {S}.

template.facts_first: Tubus brevis longitudinem habet {T} m. Puteus ad aquam, qui {M} m infra libellam maris descendit, totus tubis longis completus est, quorum quisque longitudinem habet {S} m.

template.gloss_en: A short pipe has a length of {T} m. The well down to the water, which goes down {M} m below sea level, is filled entirely with long pipes, every one of which has a length of {S} m. How many long pipes are placed in the well down to the water?
